title: Loops schedules and heuristics
summary: A collection of nouns and verbs for inert window-keyed schedule compilation, fragility half-life urgency ranking, AIMD claim pacing, UCB1 anti-stall bandit loops, seven-tier compute resource cascades and six advice-only swappable learners.
boundaries: Schedule nouns remain strictly inert data (auto_enqueued false) and never start competing background daemons.
Due-window checks perform zero storage I/O outside the active due window or past stop_at deadlines.
Swappable learners emit advice_only recommendations with keep_baseline_valid true and block contributor-restricted training traces.
Importing the pack writes nothing, enqueues nothing and installs no code.

nouns.title: A collection of nouns and verbs for inert window-keyed schedule compilation, fragility half-life urgency ranking, AIMD claim pacing, UCB1 anti-stall bandit loops, seven-tier compute resource cascades and six advice-only swappable learners

value.lets_workers: Compile inert Schedule Nouns into deterministic window-keyed idempotency keys with hash-seeded jitter, zero-I/O due-window gates, stop_at deadlines, exponential backoff and systemd --user templates, rank stale work via fragility half-life urgency, pace claims with AIMD fair-share control, prevent search plateaus via UCB1 plus tombstone suppression, route tasks across a 7-tier compute cascade and evaluate six advice-only swappable learners.

flow.when: Evaluate inert schedule windows, fragility half-life urgency rankings, AIMD claim concurrency and optional systemd --user unit templates.
Select UCB1 + empirical-Bayes arms with tombstone suppression and plateau query mutation, and pick the minimum-cost valid compute tier.
Run the six advice_only swappable learners while preserving deterministic baseline validity and family-grouped rights-cleared splits.

value.worked_example: Made-up hourly schedule, fragility urgency, AIMD pacing, 3-arm tombstone-filtered UCB1 loop, 7-tier compute cascade and 6-learner bundle recomputed in test_loops_schedules.py: enforces auto_enqueued false and 0 storage I/O outside due windows, halves AIMD concurrency from 6 to 3 on elevated EWMA latency, suppresses tombstoned arm.refuted-regex while detecting a 3-wave plateau, selects 0_code_shim for AST checks and 3_serverless_gpu_credit for 40k-token confidential synthesis, and splits public permissive traces by task_family_id with 0 overlap while blocking contributor-restricted and secret traces.

nouns.title: Guardrail: schedule nouns stay inert (auto_enqueued false) and perform zero storage I/O outside active due windows
nouns.category_reason: Prevents runaway background schedulers and eliminates wasted polling I/O.

value.rule: Schedule nouns claiming auto_enqueued true are rejected, and window checks outside due_start..due_end or at/after stop_at_epoch_seconds return due false with storage_io_ops 0.
value.how_it_is_checked: DeclarativeScheduleAndCadenceCompiler.evaluate_schedule_window raises on auto_enqueued true and returns storage_io_ops 0 off-window.

nouns.title: Guardrail: swappable learners remain advice-only with valid baselines and rights-cleared family-disjoint splits
nouns.category_reason: Ensures disabling any learner leaves deterministic baselines intact and blocks restricted or leaking training traces.

value.rule: Every learner stamps advice_only true and keep_baseline_valid true, and rights_cleared_training_manifest blocks contributor-restricted, secret-bearing, non-public or unapproved-license traces while grouping splits by task_family_id.
value.how_it_is_checked: SwappableLearnerAdvisors verifies zero family overlap between train_trace_ids and holdout_trace_ids.

steps: Reject auto_enqueued true, compute schedule:<id>:<window_iso> and enforce zero storage I/O outside due windows or past stop_at.

acceptance.check: BanditAntiStallLoopAndResourceHeuristic suppresses tombstoned arms and chooses the lowest-cost valid compute tier.
